import unittest
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError

from solution import Event, decode_event_batch


class DecodeEventBatchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_decodes_fields_in_any_order_and_formats_timestamp(self):
        data = (
            "category=sale|cents=1250|at=20240229T235959|id=A-1;"
            "id=B|at=20230101T000000|cents=0|category=x y"
        )
        events, ids = decode_event_batch(data, {"old"})
        self.assertEqual(events, [
            Event("A-1", "29.02.2024", "23:59:59", "sale", 1250),
            Event("B", "01.01.2023", "00:00:00", "x y", 0),
        ])
        self.assertEqual(ids, {"old", "A-1", "B"})

    def test_event_is_immutable(self):
        event = Event("x", "01.01.2020", "00:00:00", "c", 1)
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            event.cents = 2

    def test_skips_previously_seen_and_batch_duplicate_ids(self):
        original = {"done"}
        data = (
            "id=done|at=20240101T010203|cents=1|category=a;"
            "id=new|at=20240102T010203|cents=2|category=b;"
            "id=new|at=20240103T010203|cents=3|category=c"
        )
        events, updated = decode_event_batch(data, original)
        self.assertEqual([event.event_id for event in events], ["new"])
        self.assertEqual(events[0].cents, 2)
        self.assertEqual(original, {"done"})
        self.assertEqual(updated, {"done", "new"})
        self.assertIsNot(updated, original)

    def test_empty_input_returns_distinct_new_objects(self):
        original = {"x"}
        for data in ("", "  \t\n "):
            events, updated = decode_event_batch(data, original)
            self.assertEqual(events, [])
            self.assertEqual(updated, original)
            self.assertIsNot(updated, original)

    def test_empty_semicolon_records_are_ignored(self):
        events, ids = decode_event_batch(
            ";;id=x|at=20241231T235959|cents=9|category=z;;", set()
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(events), 1)
        self.assertEqual(ids, {"x"})

    def test_wrong_argument_types(self):
        for data in (None, b"", 1):
            with self.subTest(data=data):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    decode_event_batch(data, set())
        for ids in ([], frozenset(), {1}, {"ok", 2}):
            with self.subTest(ids=ids):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    decode_event_batch("", ids)

    def test_malformed_records_raise_value_error(self):
        bad_records = [
            "id=x|at=20240101T000000|cents=1",
            "id=x|at=20240101T000000|cents=1|category=c|extra=y",
            "id=x|id=y|at=20240101T000000|cents=1|category=c",
            "id=|at=20240101T000000|cents=1|category=c",
            "id=x=y|at=20240101T000000|cents=1|category=c",
            "id=x|at=20230229T000000|cents=1|category=c",
            "id=x|at=20240101T240000|cents=1|category=c",
            "id=x|at=2024-01-01T000000|cents=1|category=c",
            "id=x|at=20240101T000000|cents=-1|category=c",
            "id=x|at=20240101T000000|cents=+1|category=c",
            "id=x|at=20240101T000000|cents=1.0|category=c",
        ]
        for record in bad_records:
            with self.subTest(record=record):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    decode_event_batch(record, set())

    def test_error_is_atomic_for_caller_owned_set(self):
        original = {"old"}
        data = (
            "id=new|at=20240101T000000|cents=1|category=ok;"
            "id=bad|at=20241301T000000|cents=2|category=no"
        )
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_event_batch(data, original)
        self.assertEqual(original, {"old"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
